notes: The tutorial's core is the on-board LED on D13; the external LED circuit is optional and is included here as the circuit shown in the images.

Breadboard rows f-j are the 'b' bank in the catalogue; the image's upper half (labelled j..f) is therefore bank 'b'. Column numbers were estimated from the image: orange wire col 3, resistor cols 3-6, LED cols 6 (anode, bent long leg) and 8 (cathode), black wire col 8.
The schematic shows the resistor between pin 13 and the LED anode, and the LED cathode to GND; this matches the image wiring.
The GND header pin next to pin 13 is mapped to GND.1 (the catalogue does not say which of the GND ports it is).
The USB cable (for programming/power) is connected to the Uno without a port, since the catalogue lists no ports for it.
The resistor is 220 ohm per the text, though the catalogue name says 100 ohm; the value prop is set to 220.
